title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Pedro Spivakovsky-Gonzalez is a Lecturer on Law in the Negotiation Workshop. He has a particular interest in the applications of negotiation theory and practice to legal aid, economic development, and international relations. He has assisted and represented clients in mediations in state and federal courts in Massachusetts. He is a trained mediator and serves as […]
